messages:
elaine: Hey runtime team — were finalizing launch creative and need a concise bench sanity pass for a few model variants. can you run a small smoke and confirm methodology?

mike: Request: coldstart p95/p99, embed batch latency for our hero payloads, and a direct compare fp16 vs 8bit. also want 2 sanitized example responses for the blog.

sam: Can do. paste payloads and target model names + preferred region. any warmup policy?

elaine: Payloads: short support summarizer, long ~2k-token convo, embed batch (20 strings). Models: rwd-1-xl-fp16, rwd-1-xl-8bit, rwd-2-base-fp16 (fallback). Region: us-west1.

elaine: ```
# short prompt
{"prompt":"Summarize the user's issue and suggest two next steps."}

# long convo (array of turns)
[{"role":"user","content":"...long message..."}, {"role":"assistant","content":"..."}, ...]

# embed batch
["short text 1","short text 2",...20 items]
```

tara: Warmup matters — run both 30s and 5m so marketing can show warmup sensitivity.

beth: please capture tokenization time separately for the long convo. avoids misleading headlines.

mike: agreed. show both warmups. 200 queries per payload ok for smoke?

sam: 200 gives a quick view; 1k preferred for stable p99 offline. will do 200 now, note 1k done offline.

elaine: Timeline: smoke numbers + 2 example outputs by EOD Thursday. blockers?

sam: Ill run smoke (sam). tara will validate artifacts. runtime-bot: queue submitted. adding trace capture for p99 outliers.

tara: Need embed dataset access. @mike confirm sanitized?

mike: Confirmed and shared at marketing-drive/launch/embeds.csv. eng-runtime has access.

sam: Plan: 3 payloads x 3 variants x 2 warmups x 200 = 3600 requests. capture p50/p95/p99, tokenization split, and attach 3 traces for p99 outliers. post a 1-page summary + artifacts here.

elaine: Include one-line caveat for blog: "smoke sample; p99s from larger internal runs are within ~10%" unless you see otherwise.

tara: Will validate wording; if numbers look off we'll request a <24h rerun.

sam: Starting now. ETA smoke artifacts: Thursday 6pm PST (4781122634). will update if delayed. :rocket:
